name: Sky: Children of the Light
author: Cell
summary: Developer example with a Windows DNS probe, a shell hook and optional key mappings.
useWhen: Check Steam connectivity or learn how to make a .cell plugin.

options.title: Check DNS before Cell launches Sky

notes: Use Steam to play on PC. To use progress from Google or Apple, sign in to that Sky profile on mobile and link your Steam account from Settings → Account.
This example probes public DNS endpoints and does not request account credentials.
